data.name: Dihyat
data.gender_notes: Dihyat is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who yearns for knowledge and wisdom from the divine sources. The name Dihyat carries the meaning “A seeker of knowledge” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Dihyat usually hope their child will grow to embody a seeker of knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those on a spiritual quest for knowledge and wisdom.
data.etymology: Dihyat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “A seeker of knowledge.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dihyat total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
